name: Yoron (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Yoron town emblem in white: a disc bearing a light blue stylised letter S.
history: Municipal flag of Yoron, a town in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1966.

features.role: Yoron town emblem — a disc bearing a light blue stylised letter S
